That is not a coaching call—it is a medical and nutrition call. A 15-pound drop in a week is dangerous, full stop.

What I can do: build you a solid training block that keeps you strong through wedding week and beyond, and point you at your targets on the Nutrition tab, where the app works out safe macros from your weight and goal. A dietitian or doctor is the one to talk to about how to reach your wedding weight safely.
